source_window.dataset_title: Finding information held by HM Land Registry

field_evidence.target_search_paths: Search for land and property information can be searched by postcode, street and town, map or title number.
field_evidence.property_summary: Registered-property searches can return a free property summary with address, description, tenure and register indicators.
field_evidence.title_register: The title register provides ownership and title-number information.
field_evidence.title_plan: The title plan shows general boundaries.
field_evidence.unusual_land_search: For unusual addresses or land parcels, the guidance directs users to search by map.
field_evidence.boundary_information_limit: HM Land Registry states that it rarely holds specific boundary ownership information and advises checking the title register, title plan and filed deeds.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official information-retrieval guidance confirms that registered property can be searched by postcode, street/town, map or title number, while title plans show general boundaries and HM Land Registry rarely holds specific boundary ownership information. No target-specific title/register/plan/deed package or determined-boundary evidence is present in the verified lineage. Local OpenCode must retrieve and spatially bind the target-specific HMLR title context before any canonical parcel bbox is asserted; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry guidance is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from boundary-law semantics to the target-specific information-retrieval workflow. It identifies map/title-number search paths and the available property summary/register/plan documents, but also states that title plans show general boundaries and that HM Land Registry rarely holds specific boundary ownership information. The verified lineage contains no target-specific title/register/plan/deed or determined-boundary package, so no exact canonical parcel geometry/bbox is asserted. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
